source_tutorial.dialog_en: Tap the <Yellow>quest panel</> on the right for automatic quest progression.
Use the <Yellow>Drain Skill</> that appears above targets in Near Death.
Let's learn about the Drain Skill.
Select the <Yellow>Skills Menu Button</>.
Select the <Yellow>Drain Skill</>.
These are the effects obtained when defeating monsters with the Drain Skill.
The Drain Skill can be set to auto. Press the <Yellow>Auto Button</> to set auto mode.
Press close to close the Skills menu.

When defeating monsters with the Drain Skill, the 
[<Yellow>Adrenaline Gauge</>] is temporarily charged.
Press the [<Yellow>bag</>] button to check obtained equipment.
Click the [<Yellow>Equipment icon</>] obtained from the quest
You can equip items by pressing the [<Yellow>Equip</>] button at the bottom of the selected equipment's information popup.
Press the [<Yellow>Menu</>] button to change your Bloodshape.
Press the [<Yellow>Bloodshape</>] menu button to access the Bloodshape UI.

All Bloodshapes have designated [<Yellow>classes</>], but
you can equip Bloodshapes from other classes.
However, [<Yellow>Bloodshape Skills</>] only apply when you equip Bloodshapes of your class.
Select a [<Yellow>Bloodshape</>] you have obtained.
Press the [<Yellow>Equip</>] button to equip the selected Bloodshape.
Press the [<Yellow>Bag</>] button to select equipment for enhancement.
Press the obtained [<Yellow>Equipment icon</>.]
You can access the Enhancement UI by pressing the [<Yellow>Enhance</>] button at the bottom of the selected equipment's information popup.
Required [<Yellow>Enhancement Scrolls</>] will be automatically registered for the selected equipment.

All necessary enhancement items have been registered.
Now press the [<Yellow>Enhancement</>] button to attempt enhancement.

When the Adrenaline Gauge is charged, 
[<Yellow>Adrenaline Buff</>] effect is applied.
